notes.title: Small hotfix (1.02)
notes.content:
Just a small hotfix to solve problems with native resolutions and blurred main menu.

List of fixes (ver 1.02)
[list]
[*]native resolution not available in the options menu on some monitors - fixed
[*]blurred overlay displayed on top of the main menu - fixed
[*]HUD - inventory not aligned to the bottom of the screen on some resolutions - fixed
[/list]

Have Fun!
